title: To designate the Department of Veterans Affairs community-based outpatient clinic in French Camp, California, as the "Richard A. Pittman VA Clinic".
official_summary: This act designates the community-based outpatient clinic of the Department of Veterans Affairs in French Camp, California, as the Richard A. Pittman VA Clinic.

summary.headline: Congress renamed a VA outpatient clinic in French Camp, California, after Richard A. Pittman.
summary.what_it_does: This law names the Department of Veterans Affairs community-based outpatient clinic in French Camp, California, the Richard A. Pittman VA Clinic. It is a naming change only. It does not change the clinic's services, staffing, or funding.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 20, 2022, and the renaming took effect on that date.
